notes: Synthetic group lists (empty to five groups, member counts 0-8, sides 0-2), unit records with group words, selected unit -1 or set, target group/member including negative values, row slots up to 8 (the >7 message path), network and flight-info modes, row counts and unit counts past 255. Every callee is redirected by a 5-byte JMP to a register logger; the message pointer 0x132a74 points at a logger that preserves EDX.
